Expand this notification, type the 6-digit code, tap Send
Keep the code dialog open while you do this. Ports found automatically:
That was not a 6 digit code. Pull the notification down again and retype it.
Pairing port unknown yet. Open Kage again and tap Pair once more, or fill the two fields by hand.
Termux is not installed. In this build adb runs inside Termux, see the setup text on the Setup screen.
Termux refused the command. Enable allow-external-apps in Termux and grant the RUN_COMMAND permission, then retry.
Command sent to Termux, running in the background…
adb pair, adb connect and the start script all finished. Open Kage, every feature is ready.
Still not running. Open Termux and read the output, or use the copy buttons on the Setup screen.
Pair via notification (type the code in it)
Looking for the adb port over mDNS… (wireless debugging must be on)
mDNS found nothing. Fill the two fields below by hand (the phone shows them).

Fastest way: tap Pair via notification → open Pair device with pairing code → pull the notification shade down (keep the dialog open), expand the Kage notification, type the code, Send. Termux then runs adb pair, adb connect and the start script by itself.
Termux setup (once): install Termux, run pkg install android-tools, add allow-external-apps=true to ~/.termux/termux.properties, restart Termux. adb lives in %1$s.
